Ivy (mktg ops): Putting together Friday KPI deck and noticed a strange split: launch social impressions up 52% but demo requests flat. Anyone else see a source-level anomaly?
Sam T. (analytics): Yep. Dashboard pulls SFDC demo events; benchmark sheet uses HubSpot form completions. That will create divergences.
Leo (growth): Also check attribution window — our benchmark uses 7d first-touch; live dashboard is 30d last-touch. That shifts headline CRs a lot for webinar cohorts.
Farah (demand): I pulled a quick cohort by UTM_campaign: webinar-led traffic has higher sessions but lower immediate demo CTAs. Time-to-convert looks longer for webinar registrants.
Ivy (mktg ops): Ops-bot: "ops-bot: ETL complete (2026-03-22-19:00Z)"
Sam T. (analytics): Quick SQL snippet I used: ```SELECT utm_campaign, attribution_window, count(distinct user_id) as users, sum(is_demo) as demos, sum(is_demo)/count(distinct user_id) as cr FROM events WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-20' GROUP BY 1,2;```
Leo (growth): From session replays, some webinar traffic expects product examples; pricing page emphasizes integrations. That mismatch could explain bounce before demo request.
Farah (demand): Proposal: for the KPI slide include: (1) HubSpot vs SFDC counts, (2) CR by 7/14/30d windows, (3) quick creative matrix showing CTA copy variants.
Ivy (mktg ops): Action items: Sam add attribution toggle + dual-source counts to the visual; Farah will draft two pricing CTA variants for rapid test; Leo will collect 6 session clips highlighting expectation mismatch.
Sam T. (analytics): Will have viz updates EOD and include sample sizes.
Farah (demand): CTA variants live by tomorrow AM; we'll run for 72 hours.
Leo (growth): Session clips uploaded to the shared doc in 2 hours.
Ivy (mktg ops): We'll present one slide showing the variance and a recommended AB test. Also call out data caveats (webhook gaps, attribution windows).
ops-bot: "ops-bot: Weekly KPI sync Friday 10:00am — invite posted to #marketing."
Ivy (mktg ops): Thanks team 680. Ping here if anything blocks.
